//: release-please owns Reverb's version. See RELEASING.md.
The `node` release type is deliberate. The `rust` type can't bump a crate that inherits
`version.workspace = true`, or a root Cargo.toml without a [package] table
(googleapis/release-please#2111, still open), so don't 'fix' this to `rust`. `node` bumps
package.json and package-lock.json; the extra-files below bump the Cargo workspace version
and both workspace crates in Cargo.lock. (TOML strings come out of release-please's parser
as {value: ...} objects, hence `@.name.value`.) tauri.conf.json has no version: it inherits
the Cargo one. `scripts/check-versions.mjs` fails CI if any of these disagree.
`release-as` pins the first stable release to 1.0.0. Remove it once v1.0.0 is published.
